# Code of Conduct

AI Engineering Lab is a 24-week training program developed by Zorost Intelligence
AI Lab. People arrive here at every level: some have never opened a terminal, some
have shipped ML systems for years. Everyone is welcome, and everyone was a beginner
once.

## Our standards

**We encourage:**

- Welcoming questions at every level. There are no stupid questions here.
- Patient, specific, actionable answers ("try X in cell 3" beats "read the docs")
- Sharing what broke for you and how you fixed it. That is the curriculum's fuel.
- Credit where due: cite sources, acknowledge help, respect licenses
- Feedback focused on the work, never the person

**We do not allow:**

- Harassment, insults, or exclusion of any kind
- Mocking beginners or "just Google it" non-answers
- Spam, self-promotion unrelated to the program, or scraping issues and discussions
- Posting secrets, API keys, or anyone's private data
- Passing off others' content (including this repo's) as your own. The MIT license
  requires attribution.

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to all project spaces: issues, pull requests,
discussions, and any channels linked from this repository.

## Enforcement

Report violations to **info@zorost.com**. Maintainers will review reports promptly
and confidentially, and may remove content, close threads, or ban accounts that
violate these standards. Maintainers themselves are held to the same bar.

## Attribution

Adapted from the spirit of the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/),
version 2.1, tuned for an open training program.
